posts.name: Ameena
posts.cooked:
Holy fook those are about the most amazigly cute little buggers I have ever seen - look at their wickle EEEEAAARRS, aaaaaaaaaawwwwwwwwwww :D :D :D. How big are they likely to get when they're grown up?

Also..."Nemesis"? If he grows up to be a grumpy bugger it's your own fault ;). And if he ever manages to get with a female and unexpectedly produce another male bunny that looks like him, is that a Nemesis bonus?

posts.name: Silverleaf
posts.cooked:
They are the smallest breed of rabbit and will likely weigh under a kilo at full size. So, pretty small! The ears will get a bit bigger, but one of the characteristics of Netherland Dwarfs is small ears and a baby-like shape even as adults.

I don't think either one will be particularly grumpy as they were very chilled out when we went to visit, obviously very used to handling. Rabbits aren't generally keen on being picked up as it makes them feel unsafe. But who knows what they'll be like as they grow up? They all have different personalities. I just couldn't resist the name Nemesis because it is ridiculous for such a cute tiny thing, and I wanted a little homage to SotM, of course!

I don't think Nemesis will get to meet a female. Both are getting neutered as soon as their balls drop anyway... ;)
